summary: The discussion concluded that the X-Iceberg-Access-Delegation header should include a new enum value, "none", to indicate that the client does not require delegated access from the catalog. Draft PRs and a design document outline the proposed changes, while participants debate whether these types should be general primitives or vector‑specific, and whether a separate discussion thread is warranted. The discussion notes that V4 manifests have been switched to Parquet-only, and proposes dropping ORC and Avro data file formats. Participants agree that a separate thread is needed to address data file format changes and that the spec should remain flexible.
